role: GuiContainer subclass behind the player inventory screens: when the player has active potion effects it shifts the inventory left and draws a column of effect icons, localized names and durations.
scope_reason: The inventory screen is a played surface the agent opens and clicks, and potion effects are in scope (pot-apple-s1, pot-poison-s1), so the effect display belongs to the game the native engine plays.

members.name: field_147045_u
members.note: whether the effect column is shown

members.name: initGui
members.note: shifts field_147003_i left by the column width when the player has effects

members.name: func_147044_g
members.note: the effect column itself: icons from Potion.getStatusIconIndex, the localized name with the amplifier Roman numeral, and Potion.getDurationString

notes: Six effects (more than five: 26 pixels apart), in getActivePotionEffects' HashMap order (hunger's bucket first), an amplifier IV and a max-duration **:**; the live client iterates its potion_map by bucket, and test_hudscreens checks that order against the recording.
